allowedSourceMaterial.overview: 300 years of a remarkable musical instrument. Crafted by the Italian master Bussotti (Cecchi) in 1681, the red violin has traveled through Austria, England, China, and Canada, leaving both beauty and tragedy in its wake. In Montreal, Samuel L Jackson plays an appraiser going over its complex history.

facts.title: The Red Violin

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As an appraiser pieces together its path across Austria, England, and China, what dark secret from its 1681 creation left a trail of misfortune?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Crafted in 1681 by Italian master Bussotti, a singular red violin crosses continents over three centuries. In modern Montreal, an appraiser examines the storied instrument ahead of auction, unearthing its fraught past.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, suspenseful, and emotionally heavy; a sweeping multi-language drama suited for patient, attentive viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director François Girard frames an ambitious, multi-era drama around one instrument, weaving romance and mystery into a rich tapestry marked by artistic passion and quiet tragedy.
